regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, low-conviction regime: only 5 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate, breadth is shrinking (0.29), and there is no single dominant narrative. Because cross-sectional rank-IC is weak and rotation-timing has no forward edge, this is a focus lens only — the one usable constraint is that gate-eligible trend themes are where downside shake-out risk is best controlled.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the rotation margin between Diversified Miners (rank 1) and High-Dividend Blue Chips (rank 2) continues narrowing from 0.508. Avoiding, not shorting.
